findings.claim: Futurum 估計 Marvell 仍為 XPU 第二大業者，但 Alchip、GUC 與 Broadcom 的既有優勢是主要逆風
findings.source: Futurum Group, Marvell Q2 FY 2026 Earnings: Data Center Growth Healthy but Overshadowed by Rising Competition
findings.excerpt: Futurum's estimates continue to place Marvell as the second-largest player in XPUs this year and over the coming years. However, competition from Alchip, GUC, and Broadcom's entrenched dominance remains a key headwind

findings.claim: Marvell 的 XPU 專案面臨台灣設計服務業者（Alchip、GUC）競爭而有毛利壓力；有未證實的二手報導稱 Trainium 3/4 轉向 Alchip
findings.source: Dolphin Research 筆記（經搜尋摘要轉述，Marvell FY26 Q2 後）

findings.claim: JPMorgan 稱依一手研究與財報電話會議，Microsoft 與 AWS 現世代及下一世代 AI XPU ASIC 專案均無份額流失
findings.source: 搜尋摘要轉述 JPMorgan 評論（日期未能確認）

findings.claim: Benzinga 引 JPMorgan：自訂 AI 加速器份額 Broadcom 55–60%、Marvell 約 15%；另有部落格稱 Broadcom 約 70%（無來源）
findings.source: Benzinga 引 JPMorgan Harlan Sur / heygotrade 部落格
findings.excerpt: Broadcom, the market leader with 55%-60% share; Marvell, trailing with a 15% share

findings.claim: Digitimes 2026-01-30 標題顯示 MediaTek、Alchip、Marvell 爭奪 ASIC 第二名；內文未取得
findings.source: Digitimes, MediaTek, Alchip, Marvell clash for ASIC runner-up spot
findings.excerpt: MediaTek, Alchip, Marvell clash for ASIC runner-up spot

findings.claim: 光 DSP：Marvell 與 Broadcom 合計近 90% 份額；2025 年 5 月研究稱 Broadcom 與 MaxLinear 開始送 800G DSP 認證，報價 Marvell $90–100 對 $50–60
findings.excerpt: the main players in the market are Marvell and Broadcom, with a combined market share of nearly 90%

findings.claim: Cignal AI：相干 DSP 400G 由 Acacia 與 Marvell 主導，800G 可插拔份額之爭將更競爭
findings.source: Cignal AI, Tracking the coherent DSP supply chain 2026
findings.excerpt: At 400G, two vendors (Acacia and Marvell) dominated the DSP market. The battle for 800G pluggable market share will be much more competitive.

findings.claim: Nvidia 於 3/31 宣布 20 億美元投資 Marvell，並將 NVLink Fusion 與 Marvell XPU 服務整合
findings.excerpt: On March 31, Nvidia announced a US$2 billion investment in Marvell

note: 無獨立第三方 2026 份額實測數據；多為二手摘要。第2、3筆 excerpt 為 null（摘要為轉述，無可逐字複製原文）；as_of 為估計值（來源頁日期不明確）。
